name: Gasthaus Alpenrose
beschreibung: The Gasthaus Alpenrose is located in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The furnishings are traditional and give the house a quiet atmosphere. Guests can expect straightforward accommodation in a rural setting. The surrounding area is characterized by forests and mountains. Amenities include a restaurant and a sauna. The hotel is a starting point for hikes. Parking is available on site.
